d:
Hello, this is my first upload and my first translation. I use Gemini and Google Translate to translate it from the currently available Chinese translation on this site and then filter it with my brain. At first, I just wanted to translate for myself but then I thought "Why not share it with others too?" and so I did!

If you have any feedback, please kindly leave a comment so that I can improve the next time I translate! :D
